basic_info.description:
This beautifully remodeled 2BR, 2BA condo in San Francisco’s coveted Performing Arts District offers luxurious urban living in the full-service Opera Plaza. Nestled near the city’s cultural gems like the Opera House, Symphony Hall, Asian Art Museum, and Civic Center, this residence is perfect for those seeking convenience, elegance, and modern amenities. The condo features new luxury vinyl flooring, an updated kitchen with stainless steel appliances, updated lighting and remodeled bathrooms, along with a private balcony that brings in abundant natural light. 
        The Opera Plaza building provides a wealth of amenities: a doorman, concierge, 24-hour security, a heated pool, spa, well-equipped gym, valet laundry service, and on-site management. HOA dues cover most utilities (high-speed fiber internet, cable TV, water, garbage) and earthquake insurance, ensuring worry-free living. With on-site conveniences like a movie theater, restaurants, Peet’s Coffee, and shopping, everything you need is at your doorstep. Leased parking is also available.
        This prime location offers easy access to the trendy Hayes Valley and Valencia Corridor, where you'll find boutique shopping, dining, and entertainment. Public transportation is a breeze, with nearby stations, and freeway access to 101 and 280. The Walk Score of 97, Transit Score of 100, and Bike Score of 96 make it a pedestrian and cyclist’s paradise, perfect for those who want to enjoy everything San Francisco has to offer. This condo is ideal for first-time buyers, investors or anyone seeking a turnkey, low-maintenance home in a secure, upscale community.
